marketing.description: Upload or record a talk. Get a deep, research-backed report with actionable feedback.

auth.signInDescription: Enter your email to receive a magic link
auth.magicLinkSent: We've sent a magic link to {email}. Click the link to sign in.
auth.invalidEmail: Please enter a valid email address

dashboard.fileRequired: Choose an audio or video file.
dashboard.title: Talk title

consents.heading: Analysis consents
consents.intro: Video and expression processing are off until you turn each purpose on. Toggles are specific: pose/face landmarks, optional expression signals, and optional 30-day detailed tracking. No emotions are inferred.
consents.needsVideo: Turn on video analysis first. Expression signals and detailed tracking are not used without it.
consents.revoked: This purpose was revoked. Latest state is off.

accessibility.heading: Accessibility profile
accessibility.intro: These options change which body metrics are scored. They are stored as a preference you set, never inferred from video. Unavailable metrics are shown as N/A rather than a penalty.

keys.prefers_no_video_metrics: Do not score video body metrics

hints.seated: Turns off sway and walking metrics.
hints.wheelchair: Treated as seated for sway and walking metrics.
hints.limited_mobility: Turns off sway, walking, and gesture-amount metrics.
hints.one_handed: Uses the visible hand only; a hidden hand is not treated as a closed posture.
hints.speech_difference: Reserved for fluency options; it does not change gesture scoring.
hints.prefers_no_video_metrics: Gestures, gaze, and related video categories stay N/A.
hints.low_vision: Does not change gesture scoring; reserved for display preferences.

report.partialHint: Coverage is below 60%, so this overall is a partial score. Unavailable pillars are listed as gaps, not zeros.
report.deleteConfirm: Delete this session and all of its media and report files?
report.failedHelp: Delete this session and try another supported recording.
report.noStrengthsYet: No measured category reached the strength threshold yet.
report.noWeaknesses: No category met the weakness rule (level 2 or below with medium confidence).
report.weightsHint: Overall uses only applicable categories for this context. Weights come from scoring config {version}. Unavailable categories are omitted, not scored as zero.
report.radarCaption: Radar of available pillars. Unavailable pillars are gaps.
report.noEvidence: No timestamped evidence for this card yet.
report.level5Anchor: Level 5 is the category’s exemplary anchor in scoring config {version}.

enableHint.visual_aids: Record slides in view or attach a deck to enable this category.
enableHint.gestures_body: Record with your hands visible to get gesture feedback.
enableHint.eye_contact: Record with your face visible. Scores are audience-facing time (head orientation), not eye contact.
enableHint.facial_affect: Expression analysis is opt-in and describes visible signals only, never inner states.
enableHint.qa: Declare Q&A in the slot, or include question-and-answer turns in the recording.

keyMetricDefinitions.tm_pct_of_slot: Talk duration divided by the planned slot. Traffic-light bands follow Toastmasters timing practice (heuristic, S1).
keyMetricDefinitions.pp_wpm: Lexical words per minute of speech. The shaded band is a practitioner range; speech-rate norms depend on the type of talk (heuristic informed by S13).
keyMetricDefinitions.fl_filler_sounds_per_min: Filled pauses such as um and uh per minute of speech. At or below 5/min shows no penalty in the cited study; 12/min is clearly harmful (S12).
keyMetricDefinitions.pp_unplanned_long_pauses_per_10min: Unplanned pauses longer than the mid-sentence threshold, scaled per 10 minutes (heuristic).
keyMetricDefinitions.ec_audience_facing_ratio: Share of speaking time with the head oriented toward the audience or camera. This is a head-orientation proxy, not eye contact (heuristic).
keyMetricDefinitions.vv_pvq_median: Pitch variation quotient: standard deviation of F0 divided by mean F0 (S24).

report.fillerBenchmarks: Reference lines: 5/min (no penalty) and 12/min (harmful) from S12.
report.playbackError: Playback is not available for this session yet.
report.playerRegion: Recording player. Space plays or pauses. Left and right skip 5 seconds. J and L jump to evidence markers.
report.playerHelp: Space: play/pause. ←/→: skip 5 seconds. J/L: previous/next evidence. Evidence chips seek 2 seconds before the timestamp.
report.noFillers: No filler sounds labelled in this transcript.
report.disambiguationTitle: Filler-word readings (né / tipo / então, like / so)
report.disambiguationHint: Each ambiguous token is labelled filler or lexical from clause context (heuristic_v1). This is not an LLM judgment.
report.disambiguationEmpty: No ambiguous filler-word candidates in this transcript.
report.seriesUnavailable: This series was not produced for this session, so it is unavailable rather than plotted as zero.
